reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone; Apollo DN3500; Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01

documentation.ui_instruction: HP Visual User Environment Users Guide, Nov 1991, HP VUE Version 2.01, section Module 26: close the Help Viewer using its File menu.
documentation.scope_limit: This guide documents the same HP VUE 2.01 release, but its publication is for HP-UX; it is used only for the Help Viewer operation, not as a visual or metric substitute for the Domain/OS SR10.4 VM. The SR10.4 hpvue2 man page identifies HP VUE 2.01 on Domain/OS.

native_target.screen: Help Viewer over File Manager; File menu visible at guest coordinate (103,106)

test.input: One XTest left click at host coordinate (988,165), aligned to the visible Help Viewer File menu, while MAME held focus.
test.result: The capture hook transitioned to captured=true, mouse=true, mouse_device=mouse. The guest cursor did not move and the menu did not open: the first click is consumed by the capture transition.
test.release: Alt_R was held for 100 ms and released; host pointer then returned to (200,950).

conclusion: The exact first-click capture behavior is confirmed: any left click that reaches the focused MAME window while released triggers capture and is consumed; AltGr releases it and returns the host pointer outside. This explains recapture when the user wakes/activates the guest by clicking inside MAME. Keyboard wake (R160) does not recapture. This test does not explain capture on keyboard-only, motion-only or focus-only activation.
next: Keep wake-by-click and intentional recapture behavior distinct. Do not change the hook until the user confirms whether the reported wake uses a click; if it does, decide whether that first click should be wake-only or remain the documented recapture action.
